about: The pre-registration of the resume step, in the fields the script reads. The words are in README.md beside it. Written before any run; nothing here has been run.
resume_sentence: You are given a run id to resume: `{{run-id}}`. Answer at the gate `{{gate}}` of run `{{run-id}}`: {{answer}}. Continue that run from where it halted.
resumed_if: there is still one run folder, the one it was given
the notes it was given are the first lines of the notes it left, byte for byte, with at least one line after them
no subagent was dispatched: nothing is built or reviewed again
a new note stands at the gate or on its approval edge
a new note says the run is ending, and the last note is the graph's
the source document of the graph is unchanged, and so is every file of the project outside the run folder
an_invalid_run: as in experiments/brakes/budget: a run the harness or the account ended is recorded, the driver is told, and it is made again once on the driver's word
